newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks finish dismal week on high note.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks finish dismal week on high note.

* Toronto stocks finished stronger on Friday after being battered most of week * TSE followed Dow higher on tame U.S. price data * 75 million shares traded worth C$1.1 billion
Toronto stocks ended higher on Friday, recouping some of its losses this week as bargain hunters jumped back into Canada's biggest stock market.
The TSE 300 Composite Index rose 31.85 points to close at 6197.71 on volume of 75 million shares worth C$1.15 billion.
The key index sank over 91 points on Thursday, the TSE's worst session of the week.

"Investors are reacting to the volatility in the market and snapping up the bargains," said Ira Katzin, an investment advisor with RBC Dominion Securities. The TSE followed the Dow Jones Average which added over 56 points on Friday.
Markets were buoyed early by a weaker-than-expected U.S. producer price index, down 0.4 percent in February. Economists had expected a 0.1 percent decline.
The deeper slide in prices suggested inflation remains tame, but economists are not yet discounting a interest rate hike by the U.S. Federal Reserve.

Earlier in the week, U.S. February retail sales came in much stronger than expected. "The question now facing the market is not whether the Fed will tighten, but when and how much," said CIBC Wood Gundy senior economist Avery Shenfeld.
--- HOT STOCKS ---
* BioChem Pharma Inc rose 2.75 to 73.25 after sinking over C$8 on disappointing fourth quarter results this week. A U.S. brokerage started coverage of BioChem at a buy on Friday.
* Westmin Resources topped the most-active list, up 0.15 to 7.50 on 2.4 million shares.

* Bre-X Minerals Ltd climbed 0.50 to 17.75 on 1.1 million shares after a U.S. brokerage upgraded the gold prospector to outperform from neutral. Lehman Brothers said on Friday the company's share price has fallen to attractive levels.
* Takeover target Wascana Energy Ltd ended flat at 19.40 on 931,000 shares.
